scenes.heading: Understanding what's actually included in 'social media management'

sents.d: Understanding what's actually included in 'social media management'
Defining your specific service scope prevents both underselling and overpromising.

The term 'social media management' can mean anything from simple post scheduling to full content creation, community management, paid ad management, influencer outreach, and reporting — being specific about what you actually offer avoids confusion with clients.
Deciding early which of these services you'll offer (and which you'll refer out or decline) shapes your pricing, your ideal client type, and how much time each account realistically requires.

Being upfront that social media management doesn't guarantee viral growth or overnight results sets healthier client expectations from the start, and protects the relationship when growth is gradual rather than explosive.

take: Define your services clearly and set realistic expectations.
